en.help_tooltip: This screen allows you to manage your scouts more effectively! You can give them a specific focus, which will provide some benefits (and possibly some negatives) to your Tribe.  Some focuses are not available in classic mode.  Click on each focus to see a description of what they will do.  Focuses that target other Tribes will allow you to choose which Tribe you target.  Your focus can only be changed every 3 twelfth turns, so choose carefully.
en.what_to_focus: What should your scouts focus on?
en.no_deputy: Without a healthy elite, the Tribe has nobody to focus the scouts.
